title: Prometheus research package knowledge graph
description: graph.json at the package root. Every claim carries a verification label from the four-value vocabulary defined in references/okf-research-format.md, and a `critical` flag that the package-level verification_status derivation reads. Claim ids are content-addressed (change-rah-010): claim- plus the first 16 hex characters of sha256('<package_id>:<normalised text>'). Until change-rah-010 replaces build-graph.sh, a legacy {nodes, edges} document is tolerated by the driver's stage-07 contract but does not validate against this schema.

id.description: content-addressed claim-<16 hex> after change-rah-010; claim-NNN accepted until then

critical.description: true when the claim appears in the executive summary or as a Key Finding; the package label derivation weighs critical claims

sources.description: source ids or URLs from sources/registry.json; may be empty only when label is inferred

evidence.description: for verified: the fetched passage or artifact path that supports the exact statement; for blocked: what was attempted and why it could not complete
